newsitem.title: USA: Fuisz does CEFORM tests, to seek FDA OK.
newsitem.headline: Fuisz does CEFORM tests, to seek FDA OK.

text.p: Fuisz Technologies Ltd said Friday it successfully concluded its human clinical studies of its ibuprofen formulation called CEFORM, and it will seek U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval for it.
The company said the studies, which focused on CEFORM ibuprofen and involved human volunteers, demonstrated "significantly" faster onset of absorption than the reference product Nuprin.
As a result, the company said it is now finalizing documents for the FDA in order to generate the required data for approval of this new product.

The company said it is also applying the same CEFORM technology to additional products that would benefit from improvements in how quickly they work, such as anti-allergy compounds and anti-nausea treatments.
